meta.defaultTitle: Et si · Digital agency in Paris: software, marketing, consulting
meta.defaultDescription: Et si (&si) is a Paris agency: one software engineer and two marketing experts. Websites, custom software, automation, advertising, video and business coaching.

logiciels.name: Software & products
logiciels.intro: Your website should sell, your repetitive tasks should disappear, and the tool your business needs should finally exist. Our software engineer designs and codes these tools, then maintains them.

details.title: Websites
details.text: Fast showcase sites and online shops, easy to read on mobile, built to turn a visit into an enquiry. You stay in control of your content.

details.title: Automation
details.text: Follow-ups, quotes, invoices, syncing between your software: we find what eats your time every week and automate it.

details.title: Custom software
details.text: When no tool on the market fits the way you work, we code yours: web app, dashboard, internal tool.

communication.name: Marketing & creative
communication.pitch: Get seen by the right people.
communication.intro: A good offer nobody sees doesn't sell. Our two marketing specialists build campaigns, videos and messages that bring in customers, and measure what every euro returns.

details.title: Ad management
details.text: Campaigns on Google, Meta and LinkedIn: targeting, ads, budget, conversion tracking. A clear report every month.

details.title: Video production
details.text: Short social videos, product presentations, motion design: from script to final edit, in the right format for each channel.

details.title: Marketing
details.text: Positioning, messaging, action plan and content: we clarify what you sell and to whom, then make it known.

conseil.name: Coaching & consulting
conseil.pitch: Move forward with a plan, not by chance.
conseil.intro: Starting a company, opening a shop, reaching the next stage: we help you decide, organise and launch, with clear steps and one contact who knows your file.

details.title: Professional coaching
details.text: Regular sessions to set priorities, unblock decisions and stay on course. You no longer face the big choices alone.

details.title: Starting a business or shop
details.text: Legal status, offer, pricing, online presence, first customers: we prepare the launch step by step.

details.title: Business development
details.text: New markets, new offers, team organisation: we build the plan and follow it with you.

manifesto.label: Our method in three verbs
manifesto.text: We start by understanding what's holding you back. We organise the answer. Then we build it, with the same team from the first call to launch.

steps.text: We imagine how to make you visible: message, campaigns, videos.
We structure your business: priorities, organisation, a dated action plan.
We build your tools: website, automations, custom software.

poles.title: Three areas, one goal: your results.
poles.lead: Take one service on its own or combine them. The quote follows your needs, not a package.

whatif.title: What if…

about.metaTitle: About · Et si (&si), digital agency in Paris
about.metaDescription: The Et si team: one software engineer and two marketing experts. Our method, our values, how we work.
about.title: Three people, one project: yours.
about.lead: &si started from a simple observation: businesses need tools that work and customers who show up. Rarely one without the other.

team.proof: Several years of experience · many clients supported
team.text: Web development, automation, custom software: he designs and codes your tools, from the first mock-up to launch. He has supported many clients and makes sure what is promised is feasible, then delivers it.

team.proof: Dozens of companies supported, revenue up
team.text: Strategy, ad campaigns, results tracking: he has supported dozens of companies that saw their revenue grow. He knows how to bring in customers and prove it with numbers.

team.proof: Messages, content and videos that sell
team.text: Messaging, content, video production: gives your offer a clear voice on every channel, working hand in hand with the marketing expert's campaigns.

values.title: Direct
values.text: We say what will work and what won't. Before you sign, not after.

values.title: Concrete
values.text: Deliverables, deadlines, numbers. No jargon to fill slides.

values.title: Committed
values.text: The same team from the first call to the follow-up. You always know who to talk to.
